selection: Fixed11equityETF scope and first trading sessions2016/2020/2024; final regular minute15:59-16:00ET matches the planned next-close execution convention. Fixed before ETF strategy outcomes or quote acquisition; no substitutions for missing/wide cells.
asof: Explicit respective session date, an entity locator not a historical information vintage
byte_bound_note: Streaming decoded payload cap; retain at most one extra byte as an overflow sentinel then stop globally. No subsequent GET after overflow.
attempt_policy: One acquisition invocation; no automatic retries. Any prior request-start journal or capture metadata refuses reexecution pending separately reviewed reconciliation. Stop401/403/429 or byte budgets, retain every unattempted cell.
analysis: Byte-identical verified analyzer: [start,end), preserve raw endpoint-inclusive terminal quotes but exclude terminal observations from calculations; no pre-window carry; no stale-age cap; positive finite prices/sizes and noncrossed states mechanically valid; locked retained; crossed/invalid duration not bridged; duplicate-time last record gets duration; preserve raw conditions, exchanges, tapes, failures and hashes.

cost_rule.round_trip_formula: ceil(maximum duration-weighted mean full quoted spread in basis points across all33 complete qualifying cells))+10
cost_rule.failure: Any cell source/statistic error, incomplete pagination, missing/nonfinite/negative mean, or valid quoted-state duration below59seconds => unqualified; no fee assignment, replacement or cheaper subset.
cost_rule.interpretation: Quote-informed cost sensitivity, not realized execution calibration or upper bound. Tenbps roundtrip is an uncalibrated5bps-per-side adverse allowance. Quote states do not establish fill capacity, stale-quote executability, routing or closing-auction price. No change after seeing account returns.

access: Existing authorized credentials only, fixed historical data GET; no account/order endpoints, authentication flow, services or spending.
independent_verification: Recompute all33 cells using Decimal from retained raw payloads; verify full pagination/token/hash/source identities and coverage before declaring the cost qualified.
